{{Quote|It's victory or nothing!|Narlock|<ref name="Esseles" />}}
'''Dol Narlock''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] who served aboard Republic transport ship [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He would reach the rank of [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] by [[3627 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We won't be fighting alone. We have some very experienced volunteers. The Imps will never know what hit them. |Narlock instructing his troops|<ref name="Esseles" />}}
Some years after the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], he was involved in the defense against Sith attackers from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During the battle, Narlock gathered many soldiers and volunteers to participate during the start of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

In [[3643 BBY]], Narlock led a few soldiers during a [[Assault on the Esseles|surprise attack]] by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] on the [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']]. During the first thrust of the Imperials from the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Emperor's Glory]]'', Narlock, along with [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Vyn Asara]] and his guards, held in the hangar while an elite strike team boarded the Imperial ship and disabled its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. The ''Esseles'' crew was able to escape afterwards, following the strike team's successful attack.

Narlock participated in the full-scale [[Galactic War]] with the Sith Empire and in the [[War against Zakuul|war]] against the [[Eternal Empire]], rising through the ranks to become a [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]], and coming into the command of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Krakana (Valor-class)|''Krakana'']] and the [[Twenty-Ninth Fleet]], after serving aboard the ''[[Blazing Torch]]''. During this time, he would also become the captain of the Republic Navy's [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] [[Republic Navy dejarik team|team]], discussing new strategies with friend and fellow enthusiast [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]].<ref name="Narlock Codex" /> The ''[[Aphelion III]]'' was the most heavily-secured ship under his command.<ref name="Escape">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|Escaped Prisoner|Vice Admiral Narlock}}</ref>

Narlock had a child named [[Jesha Narlock]], who looked up to him.<ref name="Dad" />
